Sharp Table Clock Weather Station with Backlight | A104

The Sharp Table clock weather station with backlight | A104 is a premium desktop time and climate solution designed for modern homes, offices, and corporate gifting. Crafted with clean lines and beautiful sharp edges, this elegant table clock combines accurate timekeeping with real-time weather insights, making it both functional and visually striking. Its intuitive LCD display, flexible viewing modes, and excellent branding area make it a favorite for daily use and professional promotions.

Built to deliver clarity at a glance, the Sharp Table clock weather station with backlight | A104 shows indoor humidity and temperature along with easy-to-understand weather icons such as sunny, cloudy, or rainy. Whether placed on a work desk, reception counter, or bedside table, this compact weather station adds value with precision, style, and usability.

Smart Weather Monitoring with Visual Icons

This advanced table clock records minimum, maximum, and current humidity and temperature, allowing users to track indoor climate trends effortlessly. The display uses intuitive picture icons—sunny, cloudy, rainy, and more—so you can interpret conditions instantly without reading complex data. The Sharp Table clock weather station with backlight | A104 supports both Celsius and Fahrenheit, making it ideal for global users and export markets.

Dual Display Options for Every Environment

Designed for versatility, this clock offers two display options: an LCD with backlight for low-light or nighttime viewing, and a see-through LCD for bright environments. The backlight ensures excellent readability during presentations, night shifts, or early mornings, while the transparent look maintains a clean, modern aesthetic during the day.

Elegant Design with Sharp Edges

A standout feature of the Sharp Table clock weather station with backlight | A104 is its contemporary form factor. The beautiful clock with sharp edges complements modern interiors, minimal desks, and premium gift assortments. Its balanced proportions and crisp finish make it suitable for executive offices, hotels, and conference rooms.

Excellent Branding Area for Promotions

This model offers an excellent branding area on the front and sides, making it perfect for corporate branding, promotional giveaways, and custom logo printing. Brands can showcase logos clearly without interfering with the display, ensuring maximum visibility and long-term recall. The Sharp Table clock weather station with backlight | A104 is a smart choice for companies looking to merge utility with brand presence.

Choose the Sharp Table clock weather station with backlight | A104 for accurate climate tracking, refined design, and brand-ready presentation—an all-in-one solution that stands out on any category page and performs reliably every day.
